description: Test data for semantic analysis and clustering - showcases various word combinations and similarity levels

highSimilarity.description: Posts with >60% similarity - should create strong links (red lines) and tight clusters
posts: We must act on climate change now
highSimilarity.expectedBehavior: Red connection lines, single tight cluster, theme: 'climat & action & urgent'

mediumSimilarity.description: Posts with 30-60% similarity - should create regular links (blue lines)
posts: Green technology can help the planet
mediumSimilarity.expectedBehavior: Blue connection lines, looser cluster, theme: 'environ & sustain & green'

lowSimilarity.description: Posts with <30% similarity - should have no connections
lowSimilarity.expectedBehavior: No connection lines, isolated nodes, no clustering

polarizedOpinions.description: Opposing viewpoints on same topic - tests echo chamber detection
group1: Climate change is the greatest threat
Climate science is clear and urgent
group2: Economic growth matters more than climate
Jobs are more important than climate action
polarizedOpinions.expectedBehavior: Two separate clusters with red lines within each, no lines between clusters, themes: 'climat & action & threat' vs 'econom & job & growth'

bridgingPosts.description: Posts that connect different topics - tests cross-cluster connections
posts: Climate action and economic growth can coexist
bridgingPosts.expectedBehavior: Blue lines connecting to both climate and economy clusters, acts as bridge

nuancedSemantics.expectedBehavior: High similarity despite different word forms (politic/politician/politics), theme: 'politic & corrupt & dishonest'

stopWordFiltering.description: Tests that stop words are properly filtered
posts: The climate is changing and it is urgent
It is clear that climate is urgent
stopWordFiltering.expectedBehavior: High similarity despite different stop words (the, is, it, that, and), focuses on 'climat & chang & urgent'

multiThematicClusters.description: Multiple distinct themes for testing Generate Theme feature

education: Education should be accessible to all
Student debt is crushing young people
technology: Digital privacy is a fundamental right

multiThematicClusters.expectedBehavior: Three separate gold metaballs after Generate, themes: 'healthcar & medic & free', 'educ & student & univers', 'technolog & artifici & intellig'

echoChamberScenario.description: Strong echo chamber with many strong links
posts: We need to close the borders now
Illegal immigration is out of control
echoChamberScenario.expectedBehavior: Dense network of red lines (>60% similarity), single tight cluster, strong echo chamber indicator, theme: 'immigr & border & job'

posts: We should consider all viewpoints on this issue
Respectful dialogue leads to better solutions
We must listen to opposing views
deliberativeDiscourse.expectedBehavior: Medium similarity connections (blue lines), distributed cluster, theme: 'view & perspect & understand'

emotionalLanguage.description: Tests handling of emotional vs neutral language
emotional: I HATE when people ignore climate change
It's infuriating that nothing is being done
emotionalLanguage.expectedBehavior: Emotional posts cluster together (hate, furious, infuriating), neutral posts cluster separately, different themes despite same topic

synonyms: Giant firms have too much power
metaphors: The economy is a house of cards
Our financial system is built on sand
complexSemantics.expectedBehavior: Synonyms: high similarity. Antonyms: medium similarity (same topic, opposite stance). Metaphors: lower similarity (abstract language)

usageInstructions.manual: Copy posts from any test set and paste into mobile controller
usageInstructions.automated: Could be used for automated testing in future

expectedMetrics.generateTheme: Gold metaballs with theme labels for connected groups

semanticConcepts.tfIdf: Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency - weights words by uniqueness
semanticConcepts.cosineSimilarity: Measures angle between TF-IDF vectors (0-1 scale)
semanticConcepts.stemming: Reduces words to root form (running → run, politics → politic)
semanticConcepts.stopWords: Common words filtered out (the, is, and, or, etc.)
semanticConcepts.clustering: K-means groups posts into 3 semantic clusters
semanticConcepts.connectedComponents: Graph traversal finds groups of linked posts
semanticConcepts.themeExtraction: Weighted keywords from connections determine theme
